$comment: Single source of truth for the Aspect Ratio API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A box that keeps a fixed shape, so images and videos don't jump as they load.

ratio.description: Width divided by height, like 16 / 9, 4 / 3 or 1.

examples.title: 16 by 9
examples.description: For video and wide pictures. The picture is cropped to fill the box.

examples.title: Portrait
examples.description: 3 by 4, for posters and phone screenshots.

a11y: The box adds nothing for screen readers: give the picture inside real alt text, or alt="" if it's decoration.
An iframe inside needs a title ("Product demo video").
Reserving the space stops the page from shifting as the media loads.
